details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:584-586 (comment fetch jq filter) | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The terminal same-head gate trusts marker comments from any author because the jq filter selects comments solely by `<!-- REVIEW_AUTOFIX_PARTIAL_V1 -->` content.
  WHY: A commenter can forge a matching terminal marker and suppress workflow_dispatch-triggered reviews for the current head; severity differs across reviewers, with the highest assessment being major.

- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:537-672 (terminal same-head skip block) | severity=blocker | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: The embedded Python parser echoes raw values from marker comments to stdout without proper shell escaping, creating a shell injection vulnerability.
  WHY: An attacker who can create a PR comment with a marker containing shell metacharacters could cause arbitrary code execution when the shell parses the KEY=VALUE output.

- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:579-581 (parser heredoc) | severity=blocker | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: The parser regex `re.compile(r"^\s*([a-z_]+)=(.*?)\s*$")` can match malicious shell metacharacters in fenced block values.
  WHY: This enables prompt injection through crafted marker comments that contain shell commands in the key=value block.

- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:545-547 (PR_NUMBER validation) | severity=major | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: The terminal same-head skip block does not validate that PR_NUMBER is set before using it.
  WHY: An empty or unset PR_NUMBER could cause the gate condition to behave unexpectedly or fail open incorrectly.

- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:593-595 (partial_finalize validation) | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: Marker parsing accepts any value other than "true" for partial_finalize as valid.
  WHY: Values like partial_finalize=yes or partial_finalize=1 could be incorrectly accepted, leading to incorrect parsing.

- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:601-603 (head_sha format validation) | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: The head SHA comparison does not validate SHA format.
  WHY: A malformed SHA could incorrectly match if its lowercased value equals the expected prefix or malformed comparison target.

- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:614-616 (marker completeness validation) | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: The terminal decision checks resume_should_continue without verifying all required marker fields are present and valid.
  WHY: A malformed marker containing only resume_should_continue=false could trigger the skip incorrectly.

- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:552-557 (case-sensitive force-review detection) | severity=major | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: Force-review title detection uses case-sensitive grep.
  WHY: Titles containing [Force-Review] or [FORCE-REVIEW] would not trigger the bypass.

- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:560-562 (case-sensitive label matching) | severity=major | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: Force-review label matching requires exact lowercase "force-review" value.
  WHY: Labels such as "force review" or "Force-Review" would not trigger the bypass.

- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:364-366 (unused variable) | severity=nit | confidence=1
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: pr_head_sha_gate is declared in PR state fetch but only used by terminal same-head block.
  WHY: This adds noise and potential confusion to the PR state fetch that isn't used by other code paths.

- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:283 (gate env FORCE_RB_JUDGE expression) consumed at line 565 (`[ "${FORCE_RB_JUDGE:-false}" != "true" ]`); identical expression at line 2742 (retrigger_guard) | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k3]
  PROBLEM: The force_rb_judge bypass cannot evaluate to 'true' on the only production dispatch path that sets it.
  WHY: A wrapper-dispatched rb-judge run can be swallowed by the terminal same-head gate, contradicting the documented bypass contract and potentially creating a permanent wedge until a human force-review, a new push, or the kill switch is used.

- tests/test_review_autofix_terminal_same_head_gate.py: whole file (272 lines); .github/workflows/ci.yml test steps at lines 389-410, 566, 642-670, 814, 859-864 enumerate test files explicitly; no step in ci.yml, mark-stable.yml, or test-and-mark-stable.yml references the new file | severity=major | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The new contract/behaviour test suite is not registered in CI.
  WHY: The 11 tests never execute in automation, so regressions in gate wiring, parser extraction, defaults, bypasses, or ordering would not be caught; severity differs across reviewers, with the highest assessment being major.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Cost (CLAUDE.md §15): head_sha rides on the existing /pulls fetch above; the only new call is one paginated GET /issues/{n}/comments"
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml comment fetch logic
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  EVIDENCE: The comment fetch uses `gh api --paginate -X GET "repos/${REPOSITORY}/issues/${PR_NUMBER}/comments"` with `per_page=100` but does not handle pagination continuation tokens explicitly; it relies on gh CLI pagination which may not be reliable in all environments
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
